name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2510: A cold review of v2508 caught that the helper test proves the rule behaves correctly when called directly and does not prove the census calls it at all - an inline duplicate would pass identically. That is the same unjoined shape the extraction was meant to escape. The guard now replaces the rule at runtime with one reporting a sentinel on every input and requires the census assertion to notice. Also: a bare string pool would have compared characters and reported nonsense as orphans, refused now.
